# Check copied comment sentences against the documented function

The viewCert comment contains a directory sentence naming aDirToCheck, but the function accepts cert and opens the certificate viewer. This is a stale copied description at the exact study revision. Check nouns and parameters against the body when writing or preserving changed documentation. This observation does not establish a need to rewrite unrelated comments or change async command return behavior.

Scope: Comment writing: mailnews/extensions.
